<function=python>
<parameter=code>
for i,h in enumerate(history):
    sf = h.frame.segmentation
    pb = None
    for n in sf['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>50:

    print(i, h.action, "step", h.frame.step, "white bbox", pb)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
